visualCharacteristics.purpose: Shared bottom bands: grey Insights band with latest post tiles plus blue Contact Omya band with the contact form
visualCharacteristics.layout: Two side-by-side bands: grey post tiles and blue contact form; solo shows one band full width

contentPattern.structure: rows in order: Insights h2, one row per post tile (picture | date | title link), "Read Our Blog" CTA; then Contact h2, submit CTA, disclaimer paragraph. The last heading opens the contact band

usage: Footer-adjacent Insights + Contact bands used on nearly every page; use solo for a single band.
reuseGuidance: Reuse band-pair for the same content pattern on newly migrated pages; add an option class rather than forking for small visual differences.
